# ffxf_policies (Data Source)

Lists the policies available to the account, including the read-only policies provided by FFXF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ffxf_policies" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) Available policies. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Policy description.
- `document` (String) Policy document as JSON text.
- `id` (Number) Policy identifier.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `provided` (Boolean) True for read-only policies provided by FFXF.
- `roles_count` (Number) Number of roles the policy is attached to.
